items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: I remember years ago seeing Fletcher Henderson's band with Coleman Hawkins in the band,

ctx.x: I remember years ago seeing Fletcher Henderson's band with Coleman Hawkins in the band, and came -- the first hour the band played without him. And when he came, he was a sensation, absolutely. Well, this might have, in
some sense, put the bad mouth on black musicians as far as studios, because they didn't figure we could make time. We even had an inside experience in CPT --
